title: Loss of regularity for solutions to 1D degenerate quasilinear wave equations
summary: In this paper, we study the loss of regularity for solutions to one-dimensional degenerate wave equations. We first consider the linear equation \( u_{tt}=\bigl(c(t,x)^2u_x\bigr)_x \) with \(c(t,x)\sim x^p\), and then the quasilinear equation \( u_{tt}=(u^{2a}u_x)_x. \) The initial data are assumed to satisfy \( u_0(x)\sim x^α\) and \( u_1(x)\sim x^β\) near the degenerate point \(x=0\). In the linear problem, \(p\) describes the strength of the degeneracy, while \(α\) and \(β\) describe the regularity of the initial data.
